description: LLC resonant converter. Watch frequency hunting, ZCS loss, and gain saturation.

pathologies.explanation: Output oscillates slowly — the frequency command is hunting around the operating point on the gain curve. Reduce kp or add a rate limiter on the frequency command.
High-frequency oscillation near fsw — likely operating in ZCS region (between fr and fp). Increase switching frequency to move above fp.
Output cannot reach target — the gain curve does not provide sufficient gain at the operating frequency. The tank design (Lr, Cr, Lm) needs redesign.
Output never approaches target — implementation error (frequency command not reaching the gate drivers, or wrong timer mapping).
